scenes.title: Establish the relationship
scenes.situation: Entity A wants an FX forward relationship. Alex needs a clear picture of the entity, product and context.
scenes.before: People compare the request and clarify what is being asked.
scenes.after: People start from a shared, source-linked request and keep unknown context visible.

scenes.title: Separate entity and authority
scenes.situation: Person T works for B and claims to coordinate for A. That does not establish authority for a specific action.
scenes.before: Employment, group relationships and authority can be read together without being distinguished.
scenes.after: The person, employer, principal and purpose of authority are considered separately.

scenes.title: Determine applicable requirements
scenes.situation: Morgan works out which questions and evidence apply to this relationship.
scenes.before: People interpret requirements and explain what the applicant needs to provide.
scenes.after: The next request can be tied to the actual entity, purpose and remaining gap.

scenes.title: Reuse permitted evidence
scenes.situation: Morgan checks permitted information before asking the client to repeat it.
scenes.before: People gather, read and compare information from different places.
scenes.after: Source-linked candidates help people reuse suitable information and see what still needs review.

scenes.title: Request the specific missing facts
scenes.situation: Alex and Morgan coordinate a permitted request; Person T responds only to the items they can access.
scenes.before: Questions and follow-ups can be difficult for the contributor to reconcile.
scenes.after: A clear request, saved response and receipt help people understand the next step.

scenes.title: Assess evidence for its purpose
scenes.situation: A received document must be considered for a particular entity and purpose.
scenes.before: Receiving information and deciding whether it is sufficient require separate work.
scenes.after: People can review the specific use of the evidence and explain what remains unknown.

scenes.title: Define who and what to screen
scenes.situation: The team defines the people, entities and scope that need screening.
scenes.before: People assemble the relevant population and screening context.
scenes.after: A reviewable population and explicit coverage help people see what has and has not been checked.

scenes.title: Review a potential match
scenes.situation: Sam reviews a possible match for the same Person T, using the available identifying evidence.
scenes.before: The reviewer reads the person’s information beside the possible match.
scenes.after: A sourced comparison makes agreement, difference and missing information easier to inspect.

scenes.title: Assess enhanced due diligence when applicable
scenes.situation: Enhanced due diligence is considered when the separate risk rationale makes it applicable.
scenes.before: Specialists gather and assess information for the relevant risk questions.
scenes.after: Prepared context can focus the review while applicability and judgment remain explicit.

scenes.title: Investigate conflicts early
scenes.situation: Taylor can begin conflicts work from intake information while other work proceeds on its own conditions.
scenes.before: Conflicts work can already start from M1; missing context can require clarification.
scenes.after: Open questions and dependencies are easier to communicate across the parallel work.

scenes.title: Prepare and review agreements
scenes.situation: Casey works on the agreement and consumes the relevant current Credit terms.
scenes.before: People prepare and review agreements alongside other onboarding work.
scenes.after: Current terms, agreement versions and the human review remain clearly connected.

scenes.title: Assess credit risk and conditions
scenes.situation: Jordan assesses credit questions and sends the relevant agreement information to Legal.
scenes.before: People assess credit and communicate conditions for use by others.
scenes.after: The current condition and its use in an agreement can be traced together.

scenes.title: Remediate a precise finding
scenes.situation: Robin identifies a precise finding and reviews the resulting correction.
scenes.before: A finding can cause repeated communication or a broad restart.
scenes.after: People can correct the affected work and see what still requires independent review.

scenes.title: Understand open prerequisites
scenes.situation: Jamie brings together the applicable conditions for the same Entity A relationship.
scenes.before: People assemble progress from separate work and professional decisions.
scenes.after: Open prerequisites, waiting and next actions can be explained without equating one decision with overall readiness.

scenes.title: Record and communicate a scoped outcome
scenes.situation: The appropriate people record and communicate an outcome only when the necessary conditions and authority are present.
scenes.before: Recording and communicating the outcome are distinct activities.
scenes.after: A clear record links the outcome to its scope and supporting work. This story does not publish the case.

agents.proposal: 主要自适应候选1：受限下一工作建议
agents.goal: 在当前允许动作和依赖中提出可解释的下一步；不授予权限，不计算准入真值
agents.reads: role-filtered case context, factual blockers, allowed action catalogue, current dependency versions
agents.outputs: plan proposal and cited alternatives; draft task intentions
agents.writes: No direct policy, authority, condition satisfaction or clearance write
agents.stop: unknown action permission, changed scope, missing evidence, repeated no-progress, approved budget reached
agents.simple: deterministic dependencies + queue sorting + human coordination
agents.test: 是否减少无效追问和遗漏，且不跳过适用控制；相同输入预算比较

agents.proposal: 主要自适应候选2：有限证据查找与缺口规划
agents.goal: 为已批准的事实/风险问题，在获准来源中选择、停止和提出残余缺口
agents.reads: specific requirement/subject/purpose, allowed sources, prior receipts, evidence uses
agents.outputs: evidence plan, source receipt references, residual-gap proposal
agents.writes: May propose reads/drafts; no acceptance of identity, sufficiency, new access or external request dispatch
agents.stop: source budget reached, data-use boundary, contradictory critical claims, human sufficiency/authority needed
agents.simple: fixed source order + reusable extraction/comparison skills
agents.test: 同等工具权限下比固定顺序是否更少无谓查询/补件，关键遗漏不得增加

agents.proposal: 条件候选3：先验证是否需要独立运行体
agents.goal: 只规划一条finding的定界身份补证；可作为Evidence候选的一种隔离任务模式
agents.reads: specific finding and immutable query/subject/provider versions; scoped evidence access
agents.writes: No match exclusion, materiality, EDD approval, hold release or clearance
agents.stop: evidence still insufficient, material concern, missing permission, stale inputs or task budget reached
agents.test: 静态包足够则不建独立Agent；只评估未知取证路径的增量价值

issues.title: 两页相同设计原则
issues.observation: Dynamic requirements、早并行、continuous structured state同一句在两页均出现。
issues.proposed_handling: 不能仅凭此字幕声称Current静态且串行。以具体活动与泳道变化分析；问作者该句是否误复用。

issues.title: Target重复M0.1与划线M1.1
issues.observation: RM新的M0.1 initiation与Agentic M0.1 booking不同；M1.1仍可读但被划线。
issues.proposed_handling: 保留source-qualified occurrence ID；意图是发起入口重命名还是流程变化需确认，不能删除实际申请动作。

issues.title: 发送要求与向客户索取
issues.observation: M2.5在Ops；M3.3同时位于Ops组和RM独立框。
issues.proposed_handling: 区分内容责任、对外沟通与派发执行；RM-assisted设计已批准，但所有发送是否RM审批未被PPT证实。

issues.title: Target Credit删除线
issues.proposed_handling: 保留这些控制目的；源记录格式不改。D3给出待确认执行归属，不宣称银行已取消信用数据、approval或最终协议检查。

issues.title: Legal草稿来源
issues.observation: Draft required agreements → Review drafted agreements。
issues.proposed_handling: 可证实Legal动作词改变，不能证实AI从零起草。保留draft_origin和模板/人/自动化来源待确认。

issues.title: Agentic泳道里的判断与记录
issues.observation: 目标自动执行组包含judgment/sign-off词，同时存在专门human判断和批准。
issues.proposed_handling: 分开准备/执行/判断/批准/记录；演示的保守权限fixture是提案，不能说PPT已经完全确认。
issues.review_owner: Risk / QA / Control Room / clearance authority owner

issues.title: Credit required?与Legal关系
issues.observation: 菱形在图上指向Legal轨道；文字Credit required不充分说明所有Legal适用性。
issues.proposed_handling: Legal与Credit各自适用性保留；无Credit不自动等于无需Legal。五阶段也不替代真实依赖。

issues.title: F applicability四值与B/C三值冲突
issues.source_locator: Batch F §5 vs Batch B §6 and Batch C §10.1
issues.proposed_handling: 建议保留required/not_required/unknown；review_state另存。列为具体冲突，Codex先报告映射，不无声重写历史数据。

issues.title: Credit condition approved≠fulfilled
issues.observation: 已批准条件输入Legal，不等于其约束已落实。当前示例条件仅说纳入批准条件，缺具体payload可能循环。
issues.proposed_handling: 保留approval_status与fulfilment_status；有condition_spec_ref和clause/version核对才可fulfilled。没有payload时只是结构演示，不能声称商业条款已验证。

issues.title: E最终关状态缺前置事件
issues.observation: E列Conflicts、coverage、Legal execution、QA关闭，但未把全部上游关键依据写清。
issues.proposed_handling: 增加closure manifest：ownership评估→群体→required runs/复用依据→finding outcome；EDD适用性；booking/产品资格；signer权限；适用Credit最终检查；holds。缺项保持Not Ready。

issues.title: 缺评估记录不等于资料无效
issues.observation: 材料存在但充分性尚未建立，可能缺assessment，而不是source false或evidence invalid。
issues.proposed_handling: QA observation先写assessment_missing_or_unconfirmed，关联原Gap。只有实际证据评估支持才写insufficient。

issues.title: 同一spine不等于所有视图任何时刻完全相同
issues.source_locator: Batch F experience/state phrasing vs Lab Shadow State
issues.observation: Story checkpoint、操作session和Lab changed分支各有context；有意inject后差异应当存在。
issues.proposed_handling: 相同(case,scope,session,variant,checkpoint)下要求一致；Shadow变化保留明确delta，不强行覆盖Mainline或删除差异。

issues.title: 三段状态是呈现而非合并所有事实
issues.observation: NOT_READY/READY_FOR_AUTHORISATION/CLEARED可作为摘要，但不能一个字段同时承担计算、决定和发布。
issues.proposed_handling: 底层分别保存ReadinessSnapshot、ClearanceDecision、PublicationEvent；derived display有明确映射且绑定current input。

issues.title: QA与Readiness不得循环依赖
issues.source_locator: Batch E prerequisite examples and QA scope
issues.observation: QA核验condition，最终readiness又依赖QA；若QA也依赖最终ready会死锁。
issues.proposed_handling: 采用业务事实/要求→QA checks→QA signoff→readiness；readiness可持续显示pending但不作为QA完成前提。

issues.title: 全部after不得挂同一笼统benchmark标签
issues.observation: 很多参考是标准/指南或内部设计，不是银行已实施案例。
issues.proposed_handling: 每条变更有source locator、参考观察、adaptation及不可推断范围；无直接案例就写OUR，不硬找背书。
